data.name: PlaylistAddTip
data.value: Choose videos. Files and folders can also be dragged here from Explorer.

data.name: PlaylistLoadTip
data.value: Load the selected video (double-click). If a video is playing, it starts at once; otherwise the headset stays black until Play.

data.name: PlaylistRemoveTip
data.value: Remove from the playlist (Del). The loaded video only after Stop; then the file is free.

data.name: PlaylistEmpty
data.value: No videos yet. “Add …” or drag files and folders here from Explorer.

data.name: FormatProjectionTip
data.value: Automatic: from the metadata of the file (sv3d), otherwise Equirect 360°.

data.name: FormatLayoutTip
data.value: Automatic: from the metadata (st3d), otherwise guessed from the picture size. Left eye at the top or on the left.

data.name: FormatSwapEyesTip
data.value: Swap the left and right half pictures if the depth looks inside out.

data.name: FormatCubemapTip
data.value: Arrangement of the six cube faces per eye. Automatic: 3 × 2, for EAC the YouTube layout.

data.name: FormatFovTip
data.value: Field of view of the circle in degrees (60–360). Apply with Enter.

data.name: FormatCenterXTip
data.value: Circle center, 0 = left, 1 = right edge of the half picture.

data.name: FormatCenterYTip
data.value: Circle center, 0 = top, 1 = bottom edge of the half picture.

data.name: FormatRadiusTip
data.value: Circle radius as a share of the height of the half picture (0.5 = touches top and bottom).

data.name: FormatYawTip
data.value: Turn about the vertical axis. Positive: the picture turns to the left, the former center then lies on the left. Apply with Enter.

data.name: FormatPitchTip
data.value: Tilt. Positive: the former center moves up.

data.name: FormatRollTip
data.value: Roll about the viewing axis. Positive: counterclockwise, as the viewer sees it.

data.name: FormatResetAllTip
data.value: Discard all format and sound settings of this video; the sidecar is deleted (entries of others stay).

data.name: LiveViewShowTip
data.value: Shows the picture of the headset from the viewer’s point of view (both eyes combined, left half picture). Off at every start; switched off it costs no computing time.

data.name: SoundFormatTip
data.value: How the channels of the sound track are meant. Automatic: Ambisonics according to the metadata (SA3D); 4, 9 or 16 channels without information count as Ambisonics AmbiX. Channels: mono and stereo as they are, more channels mixed down to stereo. FuMa: older Ambisonics recordings (W X Y Z). Saved per video in the sidecar; the sound restarts briefly.

data.name: SoundFixedTip
data.value: On: the sound stays fixed in the video. With stereo, left and right come from two speakers in the picture; with Ambisonics the whole sound field stays with the picture. When the viewer turns the head, the sound moves with the picture. Off: the sound turns with the head (stereo unchanged, Ambisonics always heard from the front). Saved per video in the sidecar.

data.name: SoundWidthTip
data.value: Stereo only: angle of the two virtual speakers left and right of the center of the picture. Default 75°; larger sounds wider, smaller narrower (a usual stereo setup would have 30°).

data.name: SoundRefreshTip
data.value: Read the device list again (e.g. after plugging in headphones)

data.name: SoundDeviceTip
data.value: Device for the headphones. Windows default follows the default device; a device chosen here is never changed automatically.

data.name: SoundLockTip
data.value: Protects device and volume against accidental changes. Kept after a restart. Mute (M) still works.

data.name: IdleHeader
data.value: Headset while idle (before Play, after Stop, without video)

data.name: IdleChooseImageTip
data.value: Equirect 360° image (PNG, JPG). Square = top-bottom, 4:1 = side-by-side, otherwise mono

data.name: IdleChoiceTip
data.value: What the viewer sees while no video runs. Pause and end keep showing the video picture. Blackout (B) and fade work here too; blackout always stays black. Saved.

data.name: RecordingEnableTip
data.value: Writes head movement (head CSV) and operator events (event CSV), separator semicolon, decimal comma, clock of this PC. Column names and events are German in every language. Each switch-on starts a new pair of files. Stays on after a restart.

data.name: RecordingPerVideoTip
data.value: One pair of files per video: Play starts it (file name with the name of the video); Stop, the end of the video, unloading or another video end it. Pause stays in the same file. Nothing is written without a running video. Can only be changed while the recording is off; saved.

data.name: RecordingChooseFolderTip
data.value: Can only be changed while no recording runs

data.name: RecordingLabelTip
data.value: Optional, becomes part of the file names (e.g. 2026-11-08_141203_P07_kopf.csv). Not saved.

data.name: RecordingRateTip
data.value: Rows per second in the head CSV. Takes effect at once, also during a recording.

data.name: VolumeTip
data.value: Volume of the headphones (Orbivo only, not the Windows volume). Locked while “Lock sound output and volume” is on.

data.name: MuteTip
data.value: Sound off and on again, smoothly without clicks (key M)

data.name: StopTip
data.value: Back to the start, headset black

data.name: GoToTip
data.value: Type a time and press Enter, e.g. 83, 1:23, 1:23.5 or 0:01:23.5

data.name: BlackoutTip
data.value: Headset black at once, or the picture again, independent of the playback

data.name: FadeTip
data.value: Fade smoothly to black or back to the picture

data.name: RecenterTip
data.value: The current viewing direction of the viewer becomes the front of the video, for picture and sound (key R). Also applies to the next videos

data.name: ResetRecenterTip
data.value: The front of the video applies again (Shift+R)

data.name: ManualTip
data.value: Open the operator manual and the explanation of the recorded data in the browser (F1)

data.name: KeysHint
data.value: Keys: Space Play/Pause · ←/→ ±5 s · Shift+←/→ ±30 s · , / . single frame · Page Up/Page Down previous/next video · B blackout · F fade · M mute · R recenter · Shift+R reset recenter

data.name: OutputHeadset
data.comment: Line under the transport buttons: what the viewer sees.

data.name: PlaybackNothingLoaded
data.value: No video loaded. Add videos to the playlist with “Add …” or by drag and drop

data.name: GpuFailed
data.value: The graphics card could not be set up (details in the log)

data.name: PlaybackNoGpu
data.value: No video possible without a graphics card

data.name: CommandNotDelivered
data.value: The command could not be passed to the player

data.name: RestoreOneMissing
data.value: 1 video of the last playlist is missing: {0}

data.name: RestoreManyMissing
data.value: {0} videos of the last playlist are missing: {1}

data.name: PlaybackEnded
data.value: {0}: end reached, the last frame stays

data.name: VideoInfo
data.comment: codec, profile, width, height, frame rate, bit depth, color, format

data.name: VideoFormatHints
data.value: See the notes in the Format section

data.name: DecoderStarving
data.value: The buffer runs empty, the decoder is too slow

data.name: SoundNoTrack
data.value: No sound in the video (the system clock keeps time)

data.name: SoundDownmixed
data.value: Multichannel is mixed down to stereo

data.name: SoundOutputActive
data.value: {0}, {1:0.#} kHz, {2} channels, latency {3:0} ms, drift {4:+0;-0;0} ppm, dropouts {5:0} ms{6}

data.name: SoundModeBinauralFixed
data.value: binaural, sound field fixed to the picture

data.name: SoundModeBinauralHead
data.value: binaural, sound field turns with the head

data.name: SoundModeFixed
data.value: Sound fixed to the picture, speakers at ±{0:0.#}°

data.name: XrRuntimeLost
data.value: Headset disconnected{0}: Varjo Base is no longer running. Start Varjo Base, Orbivo reconnects by itself

data.name: XrNoRuntime
data.value: No OpenXR runtime reachable. Is Varjo Base running? Retrying every 2 s

data.name: XrHeadsetLost
data.value: Headset disconnected{0}. Connect the headset and switch it on, Orbivo reconnects by itself

data.name: XrNoHeadset
data.value: {0}: no headset found. Connect the headset and switch it on

data.name: XrSessionSynchronized
data.value: Running, the headset does not show the picture yet (SYNCHRONIZED)

data.name: RenderLoopAllocates
data.value: The render loop allocates (see the log)

data.name: XrBelowRefresh
data.value: Below the frame rate of the headset

data.name: RecenterLeft
data.value: The front lies {0:0}° to the left of the front of the video (yaw {1:+0;-0;0}°)

data.name: RecenterRight
data.value: The front lies {0:0}° to the right of the front of the video (yaw {1:+0;-0;0}°)

data.name: LiveViewMinimized
data.value: No picture: the preview window is minimized

data.name: LiveViewHeadsetHidden
data.value: No picture: the headset shows nothing right now (session not visible)

data.name: AutomaticWithSource
data.comment: {0} = what was found, {1} = where it comes from

data.name: OrientationInputError
data.value: Orientation: enter numbers from −{0:0} to {0:0} degrees.

data.name: FisheyeInputError
data.value: Fisheye: field of view {0:0}–{1:0}°, center 0–1, radius {2}–{3}.

data.name: SeeThroughPreview
data.value: Instead of the camera picture the preview shows a dark area

data.name: SeeThroughMissing
data.value: The headset offers no camera picture (ALPHA_BLEND missing); it then shows black

data.name: RateEveryFrame
data.value: Every frame (90 Hz in the headset)

data.name: RecordingRunning
data.comment: {0} = duration, {1} = head rows, {2} = events, {3} = file pairs

data.name: RecordingVideoRunning
data.value: Video {3} running for {0} · {1:N0} head rows · {2:N0} events

data.name: RecordingWaitingFirst
data.value: Ready, waiting for Play. Every video gets its own pair of files

data.name: RecordingWaitingOne
data.value: Ready, waiting for Play · so far {0} pair of files, last {1}, {2:N0} head rows

data.name: RecordingWaitingMany
data.value: Ready, waiting for Play · so far {0} pairs of files, last {1}, {2:N0} head rows

data.name: RecordingOffLast
data.value: Off · last recording {0}, {1:N0} head rows, {2:N0} events

data.name: DialogIdleImage
data.value: Choose a still image for idle (equirect 360°)

data.name: DialogRecordingFolder
data.value: Choose the folder for the recordings

data.name: LanguageTip
data.value: Language of the operator window and the manual. Takes effect after a restart, which Orbivo offers; the playlist stays. Recordings stay German in every language.

data.name: PlayerNoFFmpeg
data.value: No video possible: FFmpeg is missing (see the FFmpeg status line)

data.name: ImageTooLarge
data.value: Image too large (at most {0} pixels per side)

data.name: ManualMissing
ManualOpenFailed
RestartQuestion
data.value: The language changes when Orbivo starts again. Restart now? A running video and a running recording end; the playlist stays.
data.comment: Shown in both languages, the new one first.

data.name: RestartFailed
data.value: Orbivo could not restart ({0}). The new language applies at the next start.

data.name: UnexpectedError
MenuClearPlaylistTip
data.value: Removes all videos from the playlist (asks first). Not while the loaded video is shown; after Stop it is closed too.

data.name: ClearPlaylistQuestion
data.value: Remove all {0} videos from the playlist? The files stay where they are.

data.name: SoundLockedHint
data.value: Locked: device and volume cannot be changed (menu Options). Mute (M) still works.

data.name: AboutText
MenuAutoAdvanceTip
data.value: At the end of a video the next one of the playlist starts. Saved.

data.name: MenuLoopTip
data.value: The current video starts again at its end. Takes precedence over continuing automatically. Saved.
